fact: On 10 December 2025 Gabonreview reported that the CNSS, CNAMGS and ANINF had started an interoperability project to cross their social databases to detect double payment of benefits, and that the data protection authority APDPVP had written to demand its immediate suspension for lack of prior referral.
title: Transformation digitale : l’APDPVP rappelle à l’ordre et sécurise la dématérialisation au Gabon
